structured.answer: Open a securities account at Pesagot and buy the IBI ת"א-125 tracker (אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)). The page says that ends at about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, but that's for its example amounts (10,000 ₪ now + 500 ₪ a month, 70,000 ₪ put in, 7% a year), not my 30,000.

stuck.where: Amount fields on the first screen (10,000 / 500)
stuck.why: They aren't my amounts, and I couldn't change them, so the 86,045 is not really my number

stuck.where: Pesagot vs Leumi in the account list
stuck.why: I trust Leumi more, but it ends about 3,000 ₪ lower

stuck.where: Fund list, every row has a minus (−0.04% … −0.54%, −1,030 ₪)
stuck.why: Looked like losses, and it scared me until I saw the picked one had the smallest minus

findings.what: Every fund shows a minus figure, which reads like a loss and is scary
The default amounts (10,000/500) are easy to take as your own result
No clear 'what to do next' (how to open the account and buy)
Several colour legends with jargon (דמי משמרת, העמלות זו על זו)
Fee for נאמן shown as a tiny percent with no explanation
Lots of 'לא בחישוב' notes clutter the account list
